title: PrismCrawl Tripadvisor API input
description: Search Tripadvisor hotels, restaurants, and attractions, get place details, and collect reviews through the PrismCrawl API as structured JSON. You need a PrismCrawl API key; each successful request uses one PrismCrawl credit, and failed requests are free.

prismcrawlApiKey.title: PrismCrawl API key
prismcrawlApiKey.description: Your PrismCrawl API key, sent to PrismCrawl as the x-api-key header. Create or rotate it in the PrismCrawl dashboard; new accounts get 100 free credits. The key is stored encrypted by Apify and is never logged or written to the dataset.

mode.title: What to fetch
mode.description: Search Tripadvisor, or fetch the details or reviews of one place.

query.title: Search query
query.description: For search: what to look for, such as restaurants or hotels.

location.title: Location
location.description: For search: where to search, such as Austin, TX.

id.title: Place URL
id.description: For place details and reviews: the canonical Tripadvisor URL of the hotel, restaurant, or attraction, as returned by search.

sort_by.title: Review order
sort_by.description: For reviews: the order to return them in.

maxPages.title: Maximum pages
maxPages.description: How many pages to fetch (search and reviews only). The Actor stops early when PrismCrawl reports there is no next page. Each page is a separate PrismCrawl request and uses one credit.

limit.title: Items per page
limit.description: Results per page (1–30 for search) or reviews per page (1–100).

language.title: Language
language.description: Language code supported by the provider, such as en.

device.title: Device
device.description: Device presentation used for the source request. Leave empty for the default.

zero_trace.title: Zero trace
zero_trace.description: When enabled, PrismCrawl does not store the source or parsed response for these requests; only audit and billing metadata is kept. Results still appear in this Actor's dataset.
